style: Sebastian Beccacece's compact, high-intensity 4-4-2 with two disciplined banks of four. The side suffocates opponents through relentless pressing, midfield dominance and an exceptional defensive shape, playing vertically in transition. Extremely hard to break down but limited in attacking output.
recent_form: Defensively elite under Beccacece, conceding just four goals across his entire tenure during CONMEBOL qualifying. One of the most defensively sound teams in the field, though goalscoring remains a clear weakness.

key_players.name: Moises Caicedo
key_players.note: Chelsea midfielder regarded among the world's best central midfielders; the engine and ball-winner of the team.

key_players.name: Willian Pacho
key_players.note: PSG centre-back and first Ecuadorian to win the Champions League; anchors an elite defence.

key_players.name: Enner Valencia
key_players.note: All-time leading scorer (49 goals); led qualifying with six goals and remains the primary attacking threat.

key_players.name: Pervis Estupinan
key_players.note: Mobile left-back providing width, overlaps and defensive solidity.

key_players.name: Kendry Paez
key_players.note: Teenage Chelsea-owned talent (on loan at River Plate); the country's hottest young prospect and creative spark.

key_players.name: Hernan Galindez
key_players.note: Reliable shot-stopper underpinning the team's strong defensive record.

historical_news: Sebastian Beccacece took charge in August 2024 and built one of the meanest defences in world football, conceding just four goals over his tenure.
Moises Caicedo has emerged as one of the world's premier midfielders, anchoring the side.
Willian Pacho became the first Ecuadorian to win the UEFA Champions League, with PSG.
Captain Enner Valencia remains Ecuador's all-time top scorer and led qualifying scoring.
Strong defensively sound side widely seen as a tough out, but with a glaring lack of goalscoring depth.

media_sentiment.label: neutral
media_sentiment.summary: Praised as one of the tournament's hardest teams to beat thanks to Beccacece's defensive system, with persistent concern that limited attacking firepower caps their ceiling.
